name: Shahbad–Sadar Bazaar National Highway
significance: NH 152G is a branch of NH 152. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Shahbad to Sadar Bazaar, and it meets NH 152 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 152 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Zirakpur to Narwana
